result.summary: The pedestrian environment consists of a residential street with a narrow alleyway entrance that lacks ADA-compliant curb ramps and marked crossings. hazards.description: The alleyway and sidewalk junction show significant cracking and uneven surfaces, creating trip hazards.

interventions.title: Install Curb Ramps

interventions.title: Visibility Enhancements
interventions.description: Install a convex mirror or 'Watch for Pedestrians' signage to mitigate the blind corner created by the building.
